script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

JAMES, late 30s, ambitious tech entrepreneur, sits in a plush armchair, engrossed in his latest invention. His eyes dart between the blueprints and the device in his hands.

JAMES
(murmuring to himself)
This is it. This will change the world.

The doorbell rings. James looks up, annoyed.

JAMES
(calling out)
Come in.

EMMA, mid-30s, James' wife and business partner, enters the room, holding a stack of papers.

EMMA
James, you've got mail. And it looks urgent.

JAMES
(disappointed)
Not now, Emma. I'm on the brink of something groundbreaking.

EMMA
(skeptical)
Again? When are you going to realize that our company can't survive on your ideas alone?

JAMES
(defensive)
This isn't just another idea, Emma. This is the future.

INT. JAMES' LAB - NIGHT

James works late into the night, refining his invention.

Suddenly, the room shakes violently. James looks around in confusion, then rushes to the window.

EXT. CITY STREETS - NIGHT

A massive, shimmering orb hovers above the city. Its ethereal light bathes the streets in an otherworldly glow.

INT. JAMES' LAB - NIGHT

James watches in awe as the orb releases thousands of smaller orbs that rain down upon the city.

INT. NEWSROOM - DAY

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
(voiceover)
Breaking news: unknown objects have descended upon major cities around the world, releasing an unidentified energy source. The world waits with bated breath for answers.

INT. JAMES' LAB - NIGHT

James rushes to his computer and begins to analyze the energy readings from the orb.

JAMES
(to himself)
This is it. This is the key to unlocking limitless energy.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

James presents his findings to a room full of scientists and investors. They're skeptical but intrigued.

INVESTOR
James, this is fascinating. But how do we harness this energy?

JAMES
(confident)
That's where my team and I come in. We'll develop a sustainable, renewable energy source that can power the world.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James and Emma sit on the couch, watching as the world adapts to the new energy source.

EMMA
(proud)
You did it, James. You really did it.

JAMES
(smiling)
No, Emma. We did it. Together.

They share a loving gaze, their bond stronger than ever.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
